title: I'll never buy Framework hardware again
excerpt: TL;DR: This post ended up on Hacker News and got a lot more attention than I expected. I’m not trying to hurt Framework beyond repaid (pun intended); I want them to fix their support. I want them to give us what we paid for, a working laptop. ENODRAMA. Move along, there’s nothing to see here anymore.
